title: Tune into Leonida
intro: Meet the six stations Rockstar has introduced so far. Choose a sound, discover the hosts and hear the official station sample.
status: The full dial and complete playlists are still being revealed.

stations.name: Cocoteo FM
stations.body: Bachata, merengue, dembow and reggaeton bring a Latin party mix to the dial.

stations.name: Back Country Radio
stations.body: Country from the swamps and beyond. Mud Dog Mike reports on the weather from his airboat.

stations.name: AfroBank FM
stations.body: Older African recordings meet amapiano, 3-step and contemporary discoveries.

stations.name: The Chamber 106.6
stations.body: A heavy selection spanning decades of metal, rooted in Leonida’s scene.

stations.name: Flash FM
stations.body: A familiar Vice City name returns with a new host pairing and a pop-focused sound.

stations.name: Dirty South Classics
stations.body: Regional rap and hip-hop classics put the South at the center of the playlist.

listening.title: Take the dial with you
listening.body: Jason and Lucia can listen in vehicles or on foot through phone-connected headphones and earbuds. On-demand podcasts join radio, although individual talk shows and episode details have not all been introduced.

history.title: Voices that made GTA
history.intro: A look back at earlier games, separate from GTA VI’s announced lineup.

cards.title: Lazlow and Chatterbox
cards.body: Lazlow’s call-in show made Liberty City’s eccentric residents part of the journey. Fernando Martinez appeared among its guests.

cards.title: V-Rock and the Vice City dial
cards.body: The earlier Vice City game put Lazlow behind V-Rock’s microphone. Flash FM, Radio Espantoso and Emotion 98.3 gave the city distinct musical personalities.

cards.title: A running radio history
cards.body: Chatterbox later appeared as a show within LCFR. GTA IV gave Lazlow another outlet, Integrity 2.0. These are historical references, not promised GTA VI returns.

characterNotes.title: Train together
characterNotes.body: Bring both protagonists to the gym and both can exercise in the same visit. Their stats can benefit together.

characterNotes.title: Pace the workout
characterNotes.body: Workouts use stamina-based minigames. Nelson described a three-exercise session: finish the set without exhausting stamina or rushing the movement.

characterNotes.title: Training and food do different jobs
characterNotes.body: Training raises base health and stamina; food and drinks can provide temporary boosts. Eating and exercise also affect physique.

characterNotes.title: Make time for both
characterNotes.body: Shared outings such as beach walks, cycling and gym visits build closeness. The relationship is separate from the Criminal Profile.

characterNotes.title: Follow the mission’s lead
characterNotes.body: Character switching depends on the story. Some sequences lock a protagonist or switch roles deliberately, so a locked switch need not mean you missed an unlock.
characterNotes.confidence: Direct developer interview plus editorial interpretation

characterNotes.title: Check the scene with Focus
characterNotes.body: Focus can highlight nearby points of interest, including police. Use it to inspect your surroundings before committing to the next move.
characterNotes.confidence: Direct developer demonstration plus editorial advice

fitnessGuide.title: Build a stronger getaway
fitnessGuide.subtitle: Gym, food & stamina
fitnessGuide.imageHint: Official Lucia gym/weights screenshot if present in gallery; avoid unrelated training art.
fitnessGuide.summary: Fitness deserves its own practical guide linked from both protagonists. Keep it short and action-led.

steps.title: Arrive together
steps.body: Invite your partner before the gym visit if you want both protagonists to train.

steps.title: Read the exercise prompt
steps.body: Follow the movement rhythm and watch remaining stamina.

steps.title: Finish the session
steps.body: Complete the prompted exercises, then give the characters time to recover.

steps.title: Check what changed
steps.body: Compare base stats with temporary food or drink boosts before planning your next outing.

fitnessGuide.note: Membership prices, exact stat gains and the final progression balance will be checked in the release build.

implementationNotes: Use original transparent logos with suitable contrast: AfroBank and Flash have dark elements that need a light/tinted panel or backdrop, not plain black.
Square station art is 1600×1600, native transparent logos around 1000–1900px, backdrops 3840×1536, radio hero 3840×2160.

Audio samples are official Rockstar hosted promotional MP3s, HEAD verified 200 audio/mpeg; no full tracks copied. Stream only with explicit user play, label Station sample and one at a time; or link official music page.
No full radio lineup, named podcast hosts or complete episode schedules claimed. No fabricated historical returns.
Character bios already cover the eight official primary profiles in detail. Add meaningful gameplay links instead of duplicating biography.
Famitsu gym text is under 100 words here; preserve concise paraphrase when combining source-derived copy from money page.
Avoid saying workouts are required for 100% completion: not corroborated by primary sources.
